criteria: Locked product requirements, scoring thresholds, iteration isolation, asset rights, and rollback are explicit
gates.name: Specification baseline
gates.rollback_condition: Return to the signed specification tag if an implementation branch changes locked requirements

criteria: Candidate skill passes structural validation and independent forward tests
Plan and completed-artifact scores trigger refactoring at 80 or below
Large designs compare exactly three viable options
gates.name: Skill validation
gates.rollback_condition: Keep the skill project-local and do not add it to global guidance when behavioral tests fail

criteria: Each attempt starts from the specification tag without prior implementation context
Selected attempt builds and passes deterministic runtime smoke checks
gates.name: Independent implementations
gates.rollback_condition: Discard the current attempt and restore the last accepted branch or specification tag

criteria: Browser capture covers every required cinematic beat
Independent artifact-only review has no unresolved S0-S2 finding
The accepted video is synchronized to Dropbox
gates.name: Capture and independent review
gates.rollback_condition: Withdraw the rejected capture and retain the most recent accepted media artifact

criteria: Public GitHub source matches the accepted commit
Sites summary compares the attempts and its main flow works
Published artifact and rollback identity are recorded
gates.name: Verified publication
gates.rollback_condition: Redeploy the previous accepted Sites version and preserve the earlier Git tag

known_risks.description: AI review cannot establish human-perceived visual quality or comfort

evidence.description: The rubric keeps human visual acceptance separate from automated gates
